title: PR #36: refactor: host_prepare - ensure sovereign storage base and subdirectories have strict 0700 permissions with dual-privilege mapping
description:
refactor: host_prepare - ensure sovereign storage base and subdirectories have strict 0700 permissions with dual-privilege mapping

Refactored storage creation tasks inside host_prepare role to ensure the base parent directory /var/srv/songketmail (or the unprivileged path under user home) is created with strict 0700 permissions prior to deploying the 14 isolated subdirectories.

Supports unprivileged/Jules sandbox mode dynamically by omitting ownership when is_limited_environment is true, falling back naturally to the logged-in user, and explicitly mapping UID 2001 (songketmail:songketmail) on full-privilege systems.
